verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street offers an up-front viability assessment ("straight talk on viability and the exact narrative", "design the right visa up front"). Its open guides touch on individual criteria, such as tying each reference to the criteria you meet and benchmarking for high remuneration. However, nothing documents a structured, criterion-by-criterion method for evaluating a founder's evidence before filing. Missing for 10: a documented O-1A assessment process mapped to the USCIS criteria, a description of the assessment deliverable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
